value.name: Asha realizes someone stayed overnight
value.description: Asha notices the neatly placed work boots and understands they suggest someone remained in the house rather than leaving.
evidence: a pair of men's work boots stood neatly side by side, laces tucked in, as if someone had taken them off to stay rather than to leave
She kept her fingertips where they were and did not say what she had just understood

value.name: Asha withdraws from Claire and inspects the boots
value.description: Asha pulls her hand away from Claire and crosses to the back door to examine the boots more closely.
evidence: Asha drew her fingertips back from Claire's hand by degrees
and crossed the linoleum to the mat by the back door

value.name: Asha confirms the boots were recently removed
value.description: By examining the boots up close, Asha confirms they were taken off in place and not tracked in from outside.
evidence: Up close the boots told her what the angle from the table had only suggested: laces tucked, not loosened; tongues upright; a fine pale grit along the welt that had dried in place rather than been tracked anywhere into the kitchen
she crouched and turned one boot a quarter inch with two fingers, enough to see the heel was set flush

value.name: Rosa warns Asha to check the mudroom closet
value.description: Asha receives Rosa's third text message telling her to check the mudroom closet.
evidence: her phone buzzed once against her hip with Rosa's third message—*Check the mudroom closet*

value.name: Claire silently watches Asha investigate
value.description: Claire remains still and watches to see whether Asha will open the closet or return to the table first.
evidence: Behind her Claire had not moved
she understood that Claire was watching her watch the boots and waiting to see whether Asha would open the closet door or come back to the table first

value.name: Rosa orders Asha to open the closet immediately
value.description: Asha gets a second text from Rosa escalating the urgency and instructing her to open the closet now.
evidence: Asha's phone buzzed a second time against her hip
Rosa's words land harder than the last set: *Open the closet. Now.*
